name: Canyon Towhee
desc: Canyon Towhee (Melozone fusca): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 490 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The canyon towhee is a bird of the family Passerellidae. Until 1989, the canyon towhee and the California towhee were considered to be a single species which was called the brown towhee.
